title: Initial author test suite in 0deedfd bypassed native branch via MockAgentEngine; superseded by hermetic real startup suite
evidence: In the initial commit 0deedfd, native-env-seam.test.ts instantiated MockAgentEngine for tests 2 and 3, bypassing composition.ts lines 71-125 and leaving customCoreCalled/customNativeCalled unasserted. The working tree revision rectified this by removing MockAgentEngine from tests 2-4 and asserting customCoreCalled === true and customNativeCalled === true under hermetic sandbox. Verified by independent-seam-rerun.log.
impact: Historical test gap resolved in live working tree; real native startup and file effects are now verified.

title: Full product I/O acceptance of native built-in tools is deferred to compiled R3 journeys
evidence: Composition root default wiring injects NodeExecutionEnv providing all 24 required native SDK methods. Component tests prove method existence and standalone file effects, but complete end-to-end tool execution (e.g. compiled R3 native builtin read/write) is evaluated by the black-box product circuit.
impact: Component approval of seam selection does not substitute for black-box product acceptance.
